equation_summary: Modern Hopfield association = iterated softmax attention: with stored patterns Y (keys), state patterns R (queries), pattern projections (values), one update computes ξ = softmax(β·q·kᵀ) (β = scaling, default 1/sqrt(head_dim) per head, optionally learned per-head tensor) and the next query is q ← ξ·k (functional.py:337,400-419). The loop repeats per-head while update_step < update_steps_max (or unbounded when <0) AND ‖ξ_old − ξ‖₂ > update_steps_eps (functional.py:424-432); heads deactivate independently via masked_scatter. Final output = dropout(ξ)·v then out_proj. Optional static key/query/value patterns, key_padding_mask, attn_mask, add_zero_attn (zero pattern appended), bias_kv, in-Hopfield-space LayerNorm, and per-pattern input LayerNorms are external frontend options.
state_shape: none persistent (patterns are inputs or static buffers; iteration state ξ/q is internal to one call)
normalization: softmax over stored-pattern domain (per association step); optional LayerNorms on patterns/projections are external
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM `E[patterns/projections/scaling] ; repeat source association steps { U1.S(exact static/dynamic mask) } ; E[norm/output]`: each association step is exactly U1.S — softmax(β·q·kᵀ + mask)·v with per-head scaling and static/dynamic masks (functional.py:339-343, 400-422, 438-439) — with projections, pattern norms, scaling and masks all external; the iteration wrapper is external control flow over repeated U1.S calls.

CONFIRM 'Iteration/stopping, learned scaling and pattern gradients': update_steps_max / update_steps_eps per-head stopping with independent head deactivation (functional.py:150-165, 424-432), per-head learned scaling tensor applied to q each step (functional.py:339-343; __init__.py:142-146), and gradients flowing through the iteration to the (possibly static) patterns are precisely the recorded requirements.

CONFIRM 'one-step fragment only': update_steps_max=0 default performs exactly one association (ξ computed once, loop exits), which is the only fragment that maps trivially to a single U1.S call; the general iterated case needs the loop semantics recorded.

NOTE: the q ← ξ·k feedback (functional.py:334-337) makes step n+1's query depend on step n's association over KEYS (not values) — this query-refresh edge is part of the external iteration, not of U1.S itself.
direction_justification: Each association step is exactly U1.S over the stored-pattern domain with an additive mask and per-head scale; the iteration loop, stopping criterion, query refresh, projections and norms are external ordinary/control-flow structure — no new core semantics.
open_questions: Data-dependent iteration count (per-head eps-stopping) yields a variable number of U1.S calls per head/batch — the external module must record max-step bounds and how per-head deactivation maps to batched execution.
update_steps_max=None (unbounded) mode has no static trip count; the admitted envelope should pin a finite max.
Whether static patterns (key_as_static/query_as_static/value_as_static buffers) count as model parameters for the parity record must be specified.
dropout on ξ, add_zero_attn and bias_kv pattern concatenation are variant options to pin in the external graph.
